Laptop GPU TGP Explained: Why a 140W RTX 4050 Beats a 45W RTX 4060

Two laptops with the exact same RTX 4060 GPU can perform up to 35% differently depending on their Total Graphics Power (TGP). A 45W thin-and-light RTX 4060 will often lose to a high-power 140W RTX 4050 in heavy gaming titles.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

Always verify the manufacturer's TGP rating before buying. For RTX 3050 look for 75W–95W; for RTX 4050/4060 look for 100W–140W for maximum performance.
